When you are done, put your final answer between <answer> and </answer> tags.

message.content:
Let \(I = \int 3*exp(x)*sin(x) dx = 3*\int exp(x)*sin(x) dx\).

Using the standard result:

\[
\int exp(x)*sin(x) dx = \frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*sin(x) - \frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*cos(x) + C
\]

Therefore,

\[
I = 3*\left(\frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*sin(x) - \frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*cos(x)\right) + C
\]

\[
I = \frac{3}{2}*exp(x)*sin(x) - \frac{3}{2}*exp(x)*cos(x) + C
\]

<answer>(3/2)*exp(x)*sin(x) - (3/2)*exp(x)*cos(x) + C</answer>
